rules.question: How is a file written so a reader never sees half of it?
rules.note: A file opened with trunc is written in place, so a stop mid-write leaves half a file. Shipped code writes through write_file_replacing instead; the library file swap (store/upgrade_files.cpp) has its own renames and recovery and opens nothing with trunc.
